formal_case: H03 algorithm seed 11 A0 historical trace
allowed_model_inputs: simulation-known historical CFD wind for premise test only
frozen sensor tau 1.2 s and dead time 0.4 s

fixed_parameters.event_pooling: equal-weight mean log footprint across reconstructed whiffs

all_required: actual-wind memory-on median normalized true-source rank <= 0.10
actual-wind memory-on median rank is better than reversed-wind control
actual-wind memory-on median rank is better than local-wind-ray control

sensor_memory_attribution: PASS only if memory-on median rank is strictly better than memory-off; otherwise transport may pass but sensor-memory novelty does not
stop_rule: Any primary failure stops PMFS/ROS integration and cross-House execution.
